review.assessment: This change introduces `src/eval.rs`, a new module that tokenizes arithmetic input, parses multiplicative terms (`*` `/`) separately from additive operators (`+` `-`), and combines them into a final integer result. The evaluator currently splits expressions around `+` and `-`, builds parallel lists of terms and operators, and iterates backwards to reduce the list into a single value.

findings.defect: Chained subtraction evaluates incorrectly due to right-associative reduction logic instead of left-to-right evaluation.
